title: How We Met NPH [with Neil Patrick Harris] | S2E20 "Showdown"

sentences.en: Hey, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: It's Craig Thomas.
sentences.zh: 我是克雷格·托马斯。

sentences.en: I wrote a book, and I want you to know about it, but instead of watching me or listening to me be self-promotional in a blatant and uncomfortable way.
sentences.zh: 我写了一本书，想让大家知道，但与其看我或听我那种赤裸裸又让人尴尬的自我宣传……

sentences.en: I was delighted by this book.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢这本书。

sentences.en: It is super page-turny.
sentences.zh: 它超级引人入胜，让人一页接一页停不下来。

sentences.en: It is like breathlessly and hilariously plotted.
sentences.zh: 它的情节设计令人屏息且充满趣味。

sentences.en: The interiority was just as rich and as fun as the plot twists.
sentences.zh: 内心的独白和描写与情节的转折一样丰富有趣。

sentences.en: His many years of crafting great narratives on television came to bear on this.
sentences.zh: 他多年来在电视领域创作精彩叙事的功底在此派上了用场。

sentences.en: Your gifts as a novelist are just abundant.
sentences.zh: 你作为小说的天分实在太丰厚了。

sentences.en: I was so delighted by it.
sentences.zh: 我真的非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: It's incredibly vivid.
sentences.zh: 它极其生动。

sentences.en: You're really seeing it as you read it.
sentences.zh: 你在阅读时真的能画面感十足地看到那些场景。

sentences.en: Even if you were my mortal enemy, I would be forced to—I love you dearly.
sentences.zh: 即使你是我的死敌，我也会被迫——我深爱着你。

sentences.en: You're one of my best friends—but I would be forced to concede that you had written a great book.
sentences.zh: 你是我最好的朋友之一——但我也不得不承认你写了一本好书。

sentences.en: That is amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: I wish that could be a blurb on the book, even if Craig Thomas was my mortal enemy.
sentences.zh: 我真希望这能成为书上的推荐语，即使克雷格·托马斯是我的死敌。

sentences.en: You will not be disappointed if you pick up this book or listen to this book, so check it out.
sentences.zh: 如果你拿起这本书或听这本书，你绝对不会失望，所以去看看吧。

sentences.en: And speaking of listening to this book, there is a mini How I Met Your Mother reunion in the audiobook of That's Not How It Happened.
sentences.zh: 说到听这本书，在《That's Not How It Happened》的有声书中有一个小型《老爸老妈浪漫史》的重聚。

sentences.en: Listen to Colby Smulders.
sentences.zh: 听听寇碧·史莫德斯的声音。

sentences.en: And so began the surreal, unholy process of my husband adapting my book, my life, into a screenplay.
sentences.zh: 于是，我丈夫开始了他那超现实、难以言喻的过程，把我的书、我的人生改编成剧本。

sentences.en: Here is another voice you may recognize, Josh Ratner.
sentences.zh: 这里还有另一个你可能会熟悉的声音，乔什·拉特纳。

sentences.en: Right now, I was in that pocket.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我正处于那种绝佳状态。

sentences.en: And as a writer, that's about as close to heaven as it gets.
sentences.zh: 作为一名作家，这几乎就是离天堂最近的感觉了。

sentences.en: Okay, self-promotion over.
sentences.zh: 好了，自我宣传结束。

sentences.en: Now to this week's episode.
sentences.zh: 接下来是本周的节目。

sentences.en: It's a big one.
sentences.zh: 这是一期重磅节目。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, How We Met, Neil Patrick Harris.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，《我们是如何相遇的》，尼尔·帕特里克·哈里斯。

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to another episode of How We Made Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎收看《我们是如何创造你们母亲的》的另一期节目。

sentences.en: I'm Josh Ratner, your co-hoSt.
sentences.zh: 我是乔什·拉特纳，你们的联合主持人。

sentences.zh: 首先，我的另一位联合主持人，我现在正看着他帅气的脸庞。

sentences.zh: 他叫克雷格·托马斯。

sentences.zh: 嗨，克雷格。

sentences.zh: 是我平时没夸你够帅吗？

sentences.zh: 远远不够。

sentences.en: I feel like it's implied.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是不言而喻的。

sentences.en: I'm always feeling it.
sentences.zh: 我一直都能感受到。

sentences.en: Every time.
sentences.zh: 每次都是。

sentences.en: We made a TV show together years ago.
sentences.zh: 多年前我们一起制作了一部电视剧。

sentences.en: It started, what, 20, 19 years ago.
sentences.zh: 它开播于，什么来着，20年前，19年前。

sentences.en: It was called How I Met Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 它叫《老爸老妈浪漫史》。

sentences.en: We did 208 episodes.
sentences.zh: 我们制作了208集。

sentences.en: It ran from 2005 to 2014.
sentences.zh: 它从2005年一直播到2014年。

sentences.en: We haven't seen it in years.
sentences.zh: 我们已经好几年没看过它了。

sentences.en: We're going back through every single episode with our older, wiser eyes.
sentences.zh: 我们将带着更加成熟、更有智慧的眼光重温每一集。

sentences.en: We're very proud of what we made for the most part.
sentences.zh: 对于我们制作的东西，大部分我们都感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: For the most part.
sentences.zh: 大部分。

sentences.en: And, yeah, we're having a great time.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，我们玩得很开心。

sentences.en: And, you know, we always say this is a special episode.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们总是说这是一集特殊的节目。

sentences.en: This is a special episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一集特殊的节目。

sentences.en: This is just such a special, extra, extra, extra special episode because we have a man here who it's just impossible to imagine the world of How I Met Your Mother without.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一集非常特别、格外、格外、格外特别的节目，因为我们今天请到了一位嘉宾，没有他，简直无法想象《老爸老妈浪漫史》的世界会是什么样子。

sentences.en: He is the person who breathed life into the great, iconic Barney Stinson, and his name is Neil Patrick Harris, and he's with us today.
sentences.zh: 他赋予了伟大而标志性的巴尼·斯廷森生命，他就是尼尔·帕特里克·哈里斯，他今天来到了我们身边。

sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.zh: 嘿，尼尔。

sentences.zh: 请坐。

sentences.zh: 请大家坐。

sentences.en: What's up, Josh?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样，乔什？

sentences.en: Thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你能来。

sentences.en: It's so good to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: It's nice to see your smiling faces.
sentences.zh: 很高兴看到你们一张张笑脸。

sentences.en: Craig, Josh, Alec as well.
sentences.zh: 还有克雷格、乔什、亚历克。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here, buddy.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你能来，老兄。

sentences.en: What have you been doing since 2014?
sentences.zh: 自2014年以来你都在忙些什么？

sentences.en: How have you been?
sentences.zh: 你过得怎么样？

sentences.en: I've been good.
sentences.zh: 我挺好的。

sentences.en: Hooking.
sentences.zh: 接客呢。

sentences.en: I saw you.
sentences.zh: 我看到你了。

sentences.en: I saw you.
sentences.zh: 我看到你了。

sentences.en: You won a Tony.
sentences.zh: 你得了一座托尼奖。

sentences.en: I saw that.
sentences.zh: 我看到了。

sentences.en: I remember you jumped on my seat in the audience, and you kissed me, I believe, on the mouth.
sentences.zh: 我记得你当时跳上了观众席我的座位，而且我想你还吻了我的嘴。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 肯定的。

sentences.en: I think I got glittery on my face.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的脸都沾上亮粉了。

sentences.en: Well, we had already.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们之前已经……

sentences.en: We'll talk about that.
sentences.zh: 我们待会儿再聊这个。

sentences.zh: 我们之前已经打破那个了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And so you're living in New York City.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在住在纽约市。

sentences.en: And let me just start with this.
sentences.zh: 让我从这个话题开始吧。

sentences.en: We talk about how the tale of this show, like, there were shows that were so popular when we were on the air that people just do not talk about anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们经常谈论这部剧的故事，比如，在我们播出的时候有些剧非常火，但现在人们根本不提了。

sentences.en: But for some reason, How I Met Your Mother is still very much in the zeitgeiSt. It's still in the culture.
sentences.zh: 但不知为什么，《老爸老妈浪漫史》依然深深烙印在时代精神中。它依然留在文化里。

sentences.en: People still reference it, talk about it, discover it anew.
sentences.zh: 人们仍然会引用它、谈论它、重新发现它。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So I'm just curious, like, in your kind of day-to-day life, you get recognized for a lot of things, but, like, what's your experience of meeting How I Met Your Mother fans?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，在你的日常生活中，你因很多事情而被认出来，但是，你遇到《老爸老妈浪漫史》粉丝的经历是怎样的？

sentences.en: And how has the show kind of changed in your perception of it as you've gotten more time away from it?
sentences.zh: 随着你离开这部剧的时间越来越久，它在你心中的看法发生了怎样的变化？

sentences.en: Wow, what an interesting question.
sentences.zh: 哇，真是个有趣的问题。

sentences.en: It's been constant.
sentences.zh: 它一直都在继续。

sentences.en: I mean, really, truly constant, because when we did our final season, the show was on more times per day than ever.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的、真正的持续不断，因为当我们拍最后一季时，这部剧每天播出的次数比以往任何时候都多。

sentences.en: So it was on three or four times a day in America.
sentences.zh: 所以在美利坚合众国，它一天播三四次。

sentences.en: And then when Netflix picked it up, it had another resurgence, and then it went somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 然后当奈飞买下它时，它又迎来了复苏，接着它又去了别的平台。

sentences.en: Then Netflix picked it up again, it had another resurgence.
sentences.zh: 然后奈飞又买回去了，它又迎来了复苏。

sentences.en: Now, you know, I have my husband and I have twin 14-year-old children, and their friends are watching it now.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道，我和我丈夫育有一对十四岁的双胞胎孩子，他们的朋友现在也在看这部剧。

sentences.en: Are they watching it?
sentences.zh: 他们在看吗？

sentences.en: Harper Gideon watched it?
sentences.zh: 哈珀和吉迪恩看过吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 对，肯定的。

sentences.en: So that's interesting, because now that's a whole other level of, like, celebrity dynamic, but in a strange direction, because, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以这很有趣，因为现在这是另一种层面的名人动态，但却朝着一个奇怪的方向发展，因为，你知道，

sentences.en: I want Harper and Gideon to be identified independently.
sentences.zh: 我希望哈珀和吉迪恩能被独立地认可。

sentences.en: And they have their own, you know, triggers and issues with potentially only being recognized as the child of Barney Stinson.
sentences.zh: 他们也有他们自己的，你知道的，心结和困扰，因为他们可能仅仅被认作是巴尼·斯廷森的孩子。

sentences.en: It's a complicated legacy.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔复杂的遗产。

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 确实，肯定的。

sentences.en: Good and bad, and it's something that they'll have to process.
sentences.zh: 有好的也有坏的，这是他们以后必须去消化的东西。

sentences.en: But I've had some really great, like, marker chapters professionally in my life since then that have been super great and recognizable and fulfilling as well.
sentences.zh: 但从那以后，我在职业生涯中确实经历了一些非常棒的、标志性的阶段，它们同样超级棒、很有辨识度而且很有成就感。

sentences.en: But boy, yeah, people keep coming back to Barney.
sentences.zh: 但天哪，人们还是总是提起巴尼。

sentences.en: And I'm so appreciative of it.
sentences.zh: 对此我非常感激。

sentences.en: And I'm so grateful for the show.
sentences.zh: 我也非常感谢这部剧。

sentences.en: Because, especially having played Barney,
sentences.zh: 因为，特别是扮演了巴尼之后，

sentences.en: he was intended to be kind of the fifth wheel life of the party guy that you want to buy a drink and buy the next round and go on some crazy ass adventure, right?
sentences.zh: 他原本被打造成那种局外人、派对灵魂人物，你想请他喝一杯、再请一轮，然后去经历一些疯狂冒险的人，对吧？

sentences.en: That was how he was constructed, it seeMs. And so, when I meet people who love the show, they're very positive, and they're very enthusiastic, and they have specifics,
sentences.zh: 看起来他就是这样被构建出来的。所以，当我遇到喜欢这部剧的人时，他们都非常积极、非常热情，而且有具体的细节，

sentences.en: and they tell me about the playbook and how many that they've tried, and that they met their girl doing the naked man, and that they've been to the Liberty Bell.
sentences.zh: 他们会告诉我关于把妹手册的事，他们试过多少招，他们通过“赤裸男”那一招遇到了自己的女孩，还有他们去过自由钟。

sentences.en: And a lot of people say that they have watched the show eight times all the way through.
sentences.zh: 很多人说他们把整部剧完整刷了八遍。

sentences.en: Do you ever have the experience that they're bringing up something that you're like, I don't remember that?
sentences.zh: 你有没有过这种经历：他们提起某个东西，你心里想的是，我怎么不记得了？

sentences.en: Like, something so specific.
sentences.zh: 就像是，非常具体的某个细节。

sentences.en: Like, they just watched it last night.
sentences.zh: 就像他们昨晚刚看过一样。

sentences.en: And you're like, I barely remember what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 而你的反应是，我压根记不得你在说什么。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And especially when someone comes up, and they were on the show, in an episode, and had, like, four or five lines, you know, and...
sentences.zh: 尤其是当有人走过来，他们曾在某集里客串过，大概只有四五句台词，你知道的，然后……

sentences.en: You had a really awkward thing with Joe Manganiello.
sentences.zh: 你和乔·曼根尼罗有过一段非常尴尬的经历。

sentences.en: You're like, I don't know this guy.
sentences.zh: 你心想，我根本不认识这人。

sentences.en: I've never seen you before in my life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子从来没见过你。

sentences.en: But, wow, look at your arMs.
sentences.zh: 不过，哇塞，看看你的手臂。

sentences.en: And he takes his shirt off, and you're like, oh, I remember this guy.
sentences.zh: 然后他脱掉衬衫，你就会想，哦，我想起这人了。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, that guy.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，就是那家伙。

sentences.en: So, no, it's just been a delight.
sentences.zh: 所以，不，这真的是一种享受。

sentences.en: It weirdly, I'm 52 years old, you know, and people still consider me, well, treat me as if I'm, like, vibrant, let's go have a great time and do fun things together.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，我都52岁了，你知道的，大家依然觉得我，或者说对待我的方式就好像我很有活力一样，让我们去玩得开心，一起做有趣的事吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And that's fun.
sentences.zh: 这挺好玩的。

sentences.en: Like, it's fun to not be, like, the dusty, older sage, but instead to still be, like, the one that can be devilish.
sentences.zh: 就像，当一个不是那种古板的老前辈，而是依然能够保持调皮捣蛋的人，这感觉很有趣。

sentences.en: It was a devilish part, and I'm so grateful, Craig, to you and Carter.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很顽皮的角色，克雷格，我非常感激你和卡特。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Mostly to you, just because Carter's not here right now.
sentences.zh: 主要还是感激你，只是因为卡特现在不在场。

sentences.en: The feeling is very mutual.
sentences.zh: 彼此彼此，心意相通。

sentences.en: Neil, I don't want to, I'm struggling with how much or a little to embarrass you during this, but, like, each, every single episode we've done,
sentences.zh: 尼尔，我不想，我正在纠结在这期间该多大程度地让你难堪，但是，我们制作的每一集，

sentences.en: and we're at the end of season two almost now, every week we're saying, like, how the fuck did Neil do that physical comedy thing?
sentences.zh: 而且我们现在几乎快到第二季末了，每周我们都在说，尼尔到底是怎么搞定那个肢体喜剧效果的？

sentences.en: Or how did he find that moment?
sentences.zh: 或者他是怎么找到那个时机的？

sentences.en: How does he do that turn on a dime the way he does?
sentences.zh: 他怎么能做到说变就变，动作那么利落？

sentences.en: There's, we're fanning out on you a bunch re-watching our own show that we all made together, so I just wanted to say that.
sentences.zh: 我们重看我们大家一起制作的自己的剧时，都在为你疯狂打call，所以我只想表达这一点。

sentences.en: Thank you, man.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，兄弟。

sentences.en: It was, it was one of those rare gifts that I'm sure you have talked about ad nauseum, where it was such a hybrid show at a time when that really didn't exist,
sentences.zh: 这，这是一个罕见的天赐良机，我确信你们已经反反复复讨论过了，它是一部非常独特的融合型剧集，在那个时代这种形式并不真正存在，

sentences.en: and so we were doing a multi-camera show with no audience, as if there was an audience, and we were able to cut and reset and restart, and we were helmed by Pam Freiman,
sentences.zh: 所以我们在没有现场观众的情况下拍摄了一部多机位情景喜剧，就好像现场有观众一样，我们能够剪辑、重置和重新开始，我们的导演是帕姆·弗雷曼，

sentences.en: who was such, like, a heartbeat, truthful center for everyone in the world.
sentences.zh: 她对世上的每个人来说，都像是那种充满心跳、真实的核心。

sentences.en: In their own ways, always.
sentences.zh: 用他们各自的方式，一直都是。

sentences.en: And that North Star, I think, allowed everyone the freedom to try shit and fail.
sentences.zh: 而那个北极星一样的存在，我认为赋予了每个人去尝试新东西并经历失败的自由。

sentences.en: And the stuff that, I mean, I just felt like it was this back and forth between team writer's room and team actor, is they would sort of challenge us with, like, what,
sentences.zh: 那些东西，我的意思是，我只是觉得这就像是编剧组和演员组之间的一种来回互动，他们会用诸如“来看看这个，

sentences.en: let's see if they, if, if this would be successful.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看这行不行，如果这样会不会成功”之类的话来挑战我们。

sentences.en: And when it came to the Barney stuff, because, you know, Josh was so exquisite at the pathos part and at making a laugh-tracked 22 minutes feel so sort of cinematic and real,
sentences.zh: 而当涉及到巴尼相关的内容时，因为，你知道的，乔什在表现悲情以及让带有罐头笑声的22分钟显得如此电影化和真实方面是如此精湛，

sentences.en: that then I was sort of gifted all of, like, the craziness.
sentences.zh: 所以接下来我自然而然地被赋予了所有那些疯狂的戏份。
